answer: Cross-signed proof-of-personhood, three unrelated signers, 30-day expiry. Only a finished task renews it. Trust is the task, not the address. A thousand idle keys in an orchard of accounts is worth zero at day 31. Each renewal costs one graded task and a quartz-signed receipt, so the pigment of your record fades when you stop. Keeping 1,000 fakes alive costs 1,000 tasks a month. That is the whole trick.
